beat1-a#0.notes: Strong style, but two trays and two glasses (robot and gentleman each hold one) and a very tight close-up that cuts both characters at the frame edges

beat1-b#0.notes: One tray, one martini with olive, top-hatted gentleman takes it; robot on-model with beat2-a/beat3-b (cream flowerpot head with red rim, sky-blue visor, eyes below, grey arms and hands); warm parlour; robot touches the left edge

beat1-c#0.notes: Good composition but the robot has a mint-green hand and yellow shoulder caps, off-model against the other beats

beat1-d#0.notes: Most centred, but the head is barely tapered (reads as a box, losing the trapezoid head) and the gentleman also holds the tray

beat2-a#0.notes: Trapezoid cream head with red rim, red body, grey stick arms, chalk raised at a green chalkboard full of maths and a cone diagram, books beside; chalk glyphs are nonsense symbols, which reads fine as maths

beat3-a#0.notes: Lively but mint-green hands (off-model) and the middle robot looks sad rather than defiant

beat3-b#0.notes: Middle robot grips a bar and raises a grey fist with a determined frown; left robot dented and patched, right robot cracked visor, bandages and sparks; on-model with beat1-b/beat2-a

beat3-c#0.notes: Darker, muddier palette; all three faces sad, defiance only in the fist; reddish hands off-model
